notes: The far voice is levelled between their words at the receiver (toward -20 dBFS, 1 dB per move, one move per 2 s, only in a pause, never a peak past -1 dBFS; --far-level off); a little of your own voice on headphones (-16 dB, ~5 ms, off on speakers and on phone-mode headsets; --sidetone); the far room's floor rides the 1 Hz probe as one byte so a concealment gap fades to the real room, not dead silence; the microphone's high-pass moves from 65 to 55 Hz (the naturalness line; 50 is the mains here); a waiting gain move now takes the first real pause (10 Hz check); net_svc_mark reads back once past 300 sends.
